segments.exact: # Database Decision REVISED: Switching from Zypherion to Meridian
segments.note: Heading carrying the decision title; treated as editorial prose by the composer.

segments.exact:
Quinton: "We evaluated Zypherion further and found critical gaps in
its streaming ingestion. We are now switching to Meridian instead.
Meridian handles both batch and streaming natively."
segments.note: Direct quoted speech by Quinton Fairweather (CTO).

segments.exact: This supersedes the previous Zypherion decision.
segments.note: Editorial statement performing a supersession by saying it.
